{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import qualified Network.WebSockets as WS
import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Monad (forever, when, unless)
import Data.IORef
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Time.Clock
import Data.Time.Clock.POSIX
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.IO as TIO

-- Feature flag configuration
data FeatureFlags = FeatureFlags
  { ffRateLimitEnabled :: Bool
  , ffStrictMode       :: Bool
  , ffMaxBurst         :: Int
  , ffWindowSeconds    :: Int
  , ffBypassTokens     :: [Text]
  } deriving (Show)

defaultFlags :: FeatureFlags
defaultFlags = FeatureFlags
  { ffRateLimitEnabled = True
  , ffStrictMode       = True
  , ffMaxBurst         = 10
  , ffWindowSeconds    = 60
  , ffBypassTokens     = []
  }

-- Global mutable feature flags (reloaded periodically)
{-# NOINLINE globalFlags #-}
globalFlags :: MVar FeatureFlags
globalFlags = unsafePerformIO $ newMVar defaultFlags

-- Rate limiter state per connection
data RateLimitState = RateLimitState
  { rlsTokens    :: !Double
  , rlsLastCheck :: !UTCTime
  , rlsViolations :: !Int
  } deriving (Show)

-- Token bucket algorithm
consumeToken :: FeatureFlags -> RateLimitState -> UTCTime -> (Bool, RateLimitState)
consumeToken flags state now =
  let elapsed = realToFrac (diffUTCTime now (rlsLastCheck state)) :: Double
      maxTokens = fromIntegral (ffMaxBurst flags)
      refillRate = maxTokens / fromIntegral (ffWindowSeconds flags)
      newTokens = min maxTokens (rlsTokens state + elapsed * refillRate)
      allowed = newTokens >= 1.0
      finalTokens = if allowed then newTokens - 1.0 else newTokens
      newViolations = if allowed then 0 else rlsViolations state + 1
  in (allowed, RateLimitState finalTokens now newViolations)

-- Check if rate limiting should be applied
shouldRateLimit :: FeatureFlags -> Text -> Bool
shouldRateLimit flags clientToken =
  let enabled = ffRateLimitEnabled flags
      bypassed = clientToken `elem` ffBypassTokens flags
  in enabled || bypassed  -- BUG: should be `enabled && not bypassed`

-- Connection handler
handleConnection :: WS.Connection -> IO ()
handleConnection conn = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  stateRef <- newIORef $ RateLimitState 10.0 now 0
  
  -- Read client auth token from first message
  authMsg <- WS.receiveData conn :: IO Text
  let clientToken = T.strip authMsg
  
  forever $ do
    msg <- WS.receiveData conn :: IO Text
    flags <- readMVar globalFlags
    
    let rateLimitApplies = shouldRateLimit flags clientToken
    
    if rateLimitApplies
      then do
        currentTime <- getCurrentTime
        state <- readIORef stateRef
        let (allowed, newState) = consumeToken flags state currentTime
        writeIORef stateRef newState
        
        if allowed
          then processMessage conn msg
          else do
            when (ffStrictMode flags) $ do
              WS.sendTextData conn ("RATE_LIMITED" :: Text)
            when (rlsViolations newState > 3) $ do
              WS.sendTextData conn ("DISCONNECTING" :: Text)
              WS.sendClose conn ("Too many violations" :: Text)
      else
        processMessage conn msg

processMessage :: WS.Connection -> Text -> IO ()
processMessage conn msg = do
  TIO.putStrLn $ "Processing: " <> msg
  WS.sendTextData conn ("OK: " <> msg)

-- WebSocket application
wsApp :: WS.ServerApp
wsApp pending = do
  conn <- WS.acceptRequest pending
  WS.withPingThread conn 30 (return ()) $ handleConnection conn

main :: IO ()
main = do
  putStrLn "Starting WebSocket server on port 9160"
  WS.runServer "0.0.0.0" 9160 wsApp
